name: Taijoku ~Toraware no Elf~
source:
An elf boy, Aisle, stepped carelessly into the deep forest with his childhood friend, Sasha.
There they meet Orga, an evil creature.
Sasha is captured and become his sex doll.
Can they manage to escape safely?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE043563.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
精灵男孩艾斯勒和儿时好友萨莎无意中走进了森林深处。
在那里他们遇到了邪恶的生物奥尔加。
萨沙被抓获并成为他的性玩偶。
他们能否安全逃脱？
